status: Architecture/correctness design accepted for implementation; no implementation or validation claim
owner: Internal verifier-only per-expression-use/context DAG traversal utility; no global IRVisitor/IRMutator change
cache_lifetime: Fresh at outermost expression-use entry; RAII recursive depth; destroyed at final exit. No entries survive another top-level use, definition or scope transition.

context_clients.BufferIRVisitor: actual attribute/type/window role + direct statement result/call role
context_clients.SSAVerifier: one use under unchanged active definitions
context_clients.UseAfterDefChecker: one use, ordinary versus type-visiting mode
context_clients.TypeChecker: one use, unchanged per-function provenance state
context_clients.ManualDepsOnSubmitOnly: one use, all statement occurrences retained
context_clients.AssignmentCountAndSymmetry: statement-only traversal; preserve every definition and existing type comparison
context_clients.NoNestedCallVerifier: separate public client with original SIMT/declarative predicate exemptions

type_collection: Only local set-producing type-var request may use context-independent DAG summaries; preserve metadata field policy and lexical use checks
diagnostics: Preserve function name/category/span/text; remove automatic whole-function expansion from SSA errors; explicit printer unchanged
forbidden: Global Expr seen set across statements/scopes
Changing normal visitor/mutator or allocation semantics
Assuming caller ranges or alias separation
validation: Shared expression before/after definition both orders
Sibling/join/loop binder and reset scope failures
Type/attribute context and hidden Buffer references
Nested call after exempt context still refused
Existing malformed/type/lexical window and synchronization regressions
complexity_claim: Per expression-use/context distinct-DAG work only; no arbitrary shared-Tuple/printer/global-linear claim
review_gate: Independent reviewer accepted with stated context/occurrence or uniform lifetime/progress/cost obligations
